name: NOVA3 - recover, maintain, port, extend
vision: One maintainable C++ game codebase, rebuilt from legally held references, with native Windows/Linux x86_64, Android ARM64/x86_64, and iOS ARM64 support; extensible gameplay and modern rendering.

policy.source_quality: human-readable, tested, documented, reproducible builds; no fabricated matching
policy.source_verification: compiled != behaviour-matched; merged PR != verified original function
policy.data_policy: never commit original APK/OBB/SO binaries or bulk proprietary decompiler exports
policy.workers: All task issues use nova:queued and Allowed paths; reuse existing contributor AI pool
policy.unknowns: Original game inventory completeness, legal distribution, platform SDK availability and original gameplay fidelity remain independently checked

tasks.title: NOVA3 roadmap: define maintainable game engine modules and APIs
tasks.description: Inspect existing reconstructed source and document cross-platform module boundaries (platform, render, audio, input, assets, gameplay, net). Define readable C++ interfaces, ownership, naming, endian/ABI assumptions and test requirements; DO NOT replace existing source in this task.

tasks.title: NOVA3 roadmap: stage reusable native x86_64 CMake build
tasks.description: Design build configuration for Linux/Windows native x86_64 using shared reconstruction sources and CMake. Avoid platform-specific patches and keep existing build intact. Implement tests with a nonproprietary standalone fixture; explicitly record untested targets.

tasks.title: NOVA3 roadmap: set C++ quality and reconstruction evidence policy
tasks.description: Provide consistent human-maintainable C++ style, clear naming, comments for inferred behaviour, portable types, unit tests and explicit NOT MATCHED statuses. Scope plans to current source; do not claim game already playable.

stages.name: Windows, Linux, Android and iOS build layers

tasks.title: NOVA3 native port: Linux x86_64 game entry and SDL adapter shell
tasks.description: Create a platform adapter shell that isolates Linux window, input and paths from game logic; document optional SDL dependencies. Use placeholders only where missing reconstructed gameplay must be integrated later. Build/test independently of game assets.

tasks.title: NOVA3 native port: Windows x86_64 game entry shell
tasks.description: Build a Windows x86_64 native entry and portability abstraction with strict compiler/type assumptions. Do not claim a playable game until runtime integration and tests are established. Avoid binary/asset copying.

tasks.title: NOVA3 native port: Android ARM64/x86_64 NDK integration scaffold
tasks.description: Architect a shared C++ Android native layer with JNI boundary and arm64-v8a/x86_64 ABIs. Device binaries are separate from architecture-neutral source; do not copy APK/OBB assets. Add synthetic contract tests.

tasks.title: NOVA3 native port: iOS ARM64 and simulator integration scaffold
tasks.description: Design iOS ARM64 device and arm64/x86_64 simulator native bridging with an Objective-C++ boundary. Xcode/macOS toolchain required for real iOS builds; avoid claiming Linux CI can ship iOS. Preserve shared C++ gameplay core.

tasks.title: NOVA3 runtime: compose platform-independent engine subsystems
tasks.description: Create explicit subsystem composition and lifecycle for recovered asset, input, renderer, gameplay and audio modules. Use stubs with named TODO evidence when original code is unavailable. Write tests; do not assert gameplay equivalence.

tasks.title: NOVA3 validation: cross-platform smoke tests and playability gates
tasks.description: Define real testable gates: startup, asset loading, rendering, input, audio, campaign entry, save/load, clean shutdown; flag UNKNOWN until run against legally held data. Include build matrix Linux/Windows/Android/iOS.

tasks.title: NOVA3 graphics: renderer abstraction for optional modern visuals
tasks.description: Introduce maintainable renderer abstraction that can support legacy-compatible rendering and optional modern graphics. Do not overwrite reconstruction targets. Document backend capabilities and visual-fidelity vs modernisation tradeoffs.

tasks.title: NOVA3 extensions: design safe gameplay feature interfaces
tasks.description: Build an opt-in feature registry with modular code and consistent tests so future user-requested features do not require core rewrites. Document compatibility and savegame/versioning risks. Do not invent arbitrary gameplay changes.

tasks.title: NOVA3 extensions: optional graphics effects pipeline architecture
tasks.description: Create an optional, disableable modern effects extension interface with quality tiers and portability considerations; preserve baseline compatibility. No unsupported claims of rendering parity.

feature_intake: After extension API integration, an issue by an approved author labeled nova:feature-request is automatically converted into one AI planning task; a reviewed plan in coordination/feature_plans/ then becomes bounded implementation tasks.
